run_split_json: run the script to split loose JSON data files into train, dev, and test splits
run_split_json_custom_percent: run the script with custom test_percent values to control train/dev/test split ratios
run_split_json_multi_input: run the script with multiple input JSON files to merge and split them into train/dev/test
refactor_get_splits: refactor the get_splits function to support additional split configurations beyond train/dev/test
review_write_files: review the write_files function to understand how it writes split data and mapping files to disk
